file_name: The Independents Group – acquisition of entities within the Smuggler Group - Questionnaire_0.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if TIG and any of its connected entities (including K10 Holding, TowerBrook, LOV Group, Banijay Group) and the Smuggler Group are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with TIG, any of its connected entities including K10 Holding, TowerBrook, LOV Group, Banijay Group, and the Smuggler Group.
